text:
Ammonia, hypoxanthine and uric acid are the ADP-degradation products that rise in the blood during multiple-sprint sports. Repeated sprints drive adenylate kinase and AMP deaminase, releasing ammonia and hypoxanthine from muscle; hypoxanthine is then oxidized to uric acid, and all three accumulate in plasma. Urea and creatinine are not products of ADP breakdown.

CONFIDENCE: 92
